name: Veilvine Wayfinder
description: A small pendant of living Veilvine tended by its bearer — whose color shift indicates seasonal thresholds and ambient-field conditions in the Feywood and at the Border.
narrative_effects: Provides subtle visual reading of ambient-field state and seasonal transition timing — useful for druidic and ranger work.
Requires regular tending; neglected wayfinders wither within weeks.
Not a realm-trade item; given by druids or druidic-adjacent elves to practitioners who will actually tend it.

mechanical_effect.trigger: living pendant is tended and within the Feywood or Border ambient-field conditions it can read
mechanical_effect.applies_to: druidic or ranger navigation, seasonal-transition timing, and ambient-field state reading where subtle visual color shifts are useful
mechanical_effect.does_not_apply: neglected or withered wayfinders; precise map replacement; regions outside the field conditions the Veilvine can register
